nodes.name: build-impl.xml
nodes.summary: Auto-generated Ant build script for the AIRobot J2SE project, handling compilation, jar packaging, execution, debugging, javadoc generation, unit testing (JUnit/TestNG), profiling, and cleanup across 1800+ lines with extensive macro definitions and condition checks.

nodes.name: genfiles.properties
nodes.summary: Auto-generated CRC checksum file tracking the state of build-impl.xml and related generated files, used by NetBeans to detect when regeneration is needed.

nodes.name: project.properties
nodes.summary: NetBeans project properties defining source directories, classpaths with dependencies (HTTP client, JSON, JSoup, OpenCV, jSerialComm), build settings, JVM arguments, main class (com.llama4j.Llama3), and references to external projects OpenLab and PrimeFactors.

nodes.name: project.xml
nodes.summary: NetBeans project descriptor declaring the project type (J2SE), source and test roots, and references to external dependencies (OpenLab, PrimeFactors) used during the Ant build.
